No existing test references "LocalVariableName"; the BackingPropertyNamingRuleTest suppression parameterized test (lines 275-290) should be extended with a local-variable fixture, and reviewers should confirm the backing-property-naming rule actually flags local variables and whether property-naming should also be mapped.
